dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,805)>The wiiind sure does feel good today...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,805)>A melhor sensação de hoje é...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Yeah... It’s making me kinda sleepy...
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>*yawn*
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Sim... está me deixando meio sonolento...
<$comcan(1)><$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>*Aurora*

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,2)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,16)>*yaaaawn*
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)>Heyyy... <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke, your yawn made me yawn.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,2)><$motionoff(2,804)><$comeff(2,16)>* Yaaaawn *
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)>Olá... <$cdef(27)>SlowpokeO teu bocejo fez-me bocejar.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>*yaaawn* You made me yawn, too...
<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,807)>Hm...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>Fizeste-me bocejar, também...
<$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,807)>Hm...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,16)><$motionoff(2,804)>*yaaaaaawn* It happened again...
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>We’ll neeever stop yawning if this keeps happening...
<$voicel(2,2)>*yaaaaaaawn*
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,16)><$motionoff(2,804)>Aconteceu de novo...
<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>Nós nunca vamos parar de bocejar se isso continuar acontecendo...
<$voicel(2,2)>*Yaaaaaawn *

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>*yawn* All this yawning is...starting to make me feel...
really...sleepy...
<$comeff(1,15)><$facial(1,14)><$kfacial(1)>... ... ...
<$voicel(1,2)>Zzz...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>Todo este bocejo está a começar a fazer-me sentir...
A sério... a dormir...
<$comeff(1,15)><$facial(1,14)><$kfacial(1)>... ... ...
<$voicel(1,2)>Zzz...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,16)><$motion(2,805)>I’m kind of...starting to...get sleeeepy...toooo...
<$comeff(2,15)>... ... ...
<$voicel(2,2)>Zzzzzzz...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,16)><$motion(2,805)>Eu estou meio que... começando a... ficar soeeepy... tooooo...
<$comeff(2,15)>... ... ...
<$voicel(2,2)>Zzzzzzz...

dialogues.en:
... ... ...
<$voicel(1,8)><$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(1,14)><$emotion(2,14)>Huh?
<$voicel(1,6)><$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$motion(1,805)>Guess we dozed off...
dialogues.pt_br:
... ... ...
<$voicel(1,8)><$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(1,14)><$emotion(2,14)>Huh?
<$voicel(1,6)><$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$motion(1,805)>Acho que cochilámos...

dialogues.en: <$facial(2,9)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,3)>Why are you making that funny faaace? Are you hungry?
dialogues.pt_br: <$facial(2,9)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,3)>Porque está a fazer essa faaace engraçada?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,66)>...I think I may be able to remember something important
when I do this.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,66)>Acho que posso lembrar-me de algo importante.
Quando eu fizer isto.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>Like what you had for diiinner last night?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>Como o que comeste ontem à noite?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,67)>...I think maybe we <$cdef(27)>Slowking and <$cdef(27)>Slowbro used to walk on
all fours in the past, just like <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke does.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,67)>...Eu acho que talvez nós <$cdef(27)>Slowking e <$cdef(27)>Slowbro usado para andar sobre
todos os quatros no passado, assim como <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke Sim.

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,3)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)>Nooo... Really?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,3)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)>Não... a sério?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,806)><$comeff(2,3)>...But something must’ve happened. Something that caused
us to stand up on two legs.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motionoff(2,806)><$comeff(2,3)>...Mas algo deve ter acontecido. Algo que causou
Para nos levantarmos em duas pernas.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Whoooaaa... You’re so smart. No wonder they call you king.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Whoooaaa... Você é tão inteligente. Não é à toa que eles o chamam de rei.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,55)>But what could it have been? What changed us?
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,46)>I feel like it was something kind of unpleasant...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,55)>Mas o que poderia ter sido? O que nos mudou?
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,46)>Sinto que foi algo desagradável...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,4)>Ohhh. I have an idea... Maaaybe our tails were itchy?
<$voicel(1,9)><$motionoff(1,806)><$comeff(1,9)>It’s a lot easier to scratch with our hands, y’knooow?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,4)>Tenho uma ideia, Maaaybe, as nossas caudas estavam com comichão?
<$voicel(1,9)><$motionoff(1,806)><$comeff(1,9)>É muito mais fácil de coçar com as nossas mãos, y'knooow?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,39)>...You’re pretty clever yourself, aren’t you, dear?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,39)>...Você também é muito inteligente, não é, querida?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,6)>Hee hee...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,6)>Hee hee...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>Marowak! Yooo, sorry if this kinda sounds like it’s comin’
outta nowhere, but I seriously look up to you!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>Marowak! Yooo, desculpe se este tipo de soa como ele está vindo’
Do nada, mas eu admiro-te seriamente!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>That’s very flattering—but may I ask why?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Isso é muito lisonjeiro – mas posso perguntar por quê?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,10)>Your Bonemerang, yo!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>That BEAU-TI-FUL finesse you got throwing that bone!
It’s, like, totally awesome!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,10)>O teu Bonemerang!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Essa finesse que tem a atirar aquele osso!
É, tipo, totalmente incrível!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Ahhh, yes, thank you. It took me quite some time to
master that mo—
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Sim, obrigado.
Mestre que mo...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>And yo—hear me out! HEAR! ME! OUT! I trained REAL
hard and figured out my own move.
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,9)>I use my leek and call it...the Leekarang!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Ouçam-me! Ouçam-me! Eu treinei REAL
Difícil e descobri o meu próprio movimento.
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu uso o meu alho-poró e chamo-lhe... o Leekarang!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>You...use a leek? I must admit, that sounds like a more
impressive feat.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Devo admitir, isso soa como um mais
Uma façanha impressionante.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,10)>Whaaat? No way!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>OH! But hey! Hey! HEYYY! While I’ve got you here, <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>can I
show you it—my move?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,10)>Nem pensar!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Mas, ei, ei, ei, ei, ei, ei, ei! <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>Posso?
mostrar-lhe - o meu movimento?!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Oh yes, please do show me. I’m quite intrigued.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Oh sim, por favor, mostre-me. Estou bastante intrigado.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,7)>Heck yeah, yo! OK, here I go...
<$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>BOOM!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,7)>Pronto, aqui vou eu...
<$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Boom!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Incredible... You’ve managed to throw that thin, flimsy
leek just like a boomerang.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>But I suppose in terms of power, Bonemerang probably
remains superior.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Incrível... Você conseguiu jogar que fino, frágil
Alho-porro como um bumerangue.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Mas suponho que em termos de poder, Bonemerang provavelmente
permanece superior.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>That might be true, yo, but leeks can ALSO be emergency
rations if you ever find yourself lackin’ food!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>Isso pode ser verdade, yo, mas alho-poró também pode ser emergência
rações se alguma vez se sentirem carentes de comida!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>I...I see. This has been very educational...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Entendo, isto tem sido muito educativo.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,65)><$voicel(2,5)>Hey, pal, you seen any nice-lookin’ boulders around here?
Haven’t sharpened my tusks in a while and it’s buggin’ me.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,65)><$voicel(2,5)>Ei, amigo, você viu alguma pedra bonita por aqui?
Não tenho afiado minhas presas por um tempo e ele está me incomodando.

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>How do you sharpen your tusks, bud?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Como afias as presas, amigo?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Uhhh, so usually, I push my tusks right up against a big
boulder and just kinda...<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>scrape ’em against it, I guess.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Uhhh, então normalmente, eu empurrar as minhas presas para cima contra um grande
Pedras e apenas...<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Acho que os arranhou contra ela.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>OK, I think I get it. Maybe I could help out. I’ll just apply
a li’l pressure, and...
<$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,6)>How’s that?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>OK, eu acho que eu entendo. Talvez eu poderia ajudar. Eu vou aplicar
uma pressão li’l, e...
<$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,6)>Como assim?!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>HEY! Watch it!
<$comeff(2,18)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Yeesh, be a little more careful, will ya? I wanna sharpen
my tusks, not break ’em!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Cuidado!
<$comeff(2,18)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Tem mais cuidado, sim?
minhas presas, não quebrem!

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,4)>Oh, dang. Sorry, bud. Guess it’s trickier than I thought...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,4)>Desculpa, amigo, acho que é mais complicado do que pensei.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Actually... Hold still a sec—your body might be just hard
enough<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)> to sharpen my tusks on!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Na verdade, não se mexa um segundo, o seu corpo pode ser duro.
Basta<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)> Para afiar as minhas presas!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, yeah? Cool. I’ll stay perfectly still, then. <$voicel(1,9)>Go ahead
and do your thing.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Sim? Legal. Vou ficar perfeitamente imóvel, então. <$voicel(1,9)>Vá em frente.
e faz o que tem a fazer.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Thanks, pal! OK, here goes nothing...
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>*scrape scrape scrape*
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Obrigado, amigo!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>Raspa-se a raspagem

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,9)>Ahaha! AHHH! That tickles!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,9)>Isso faz cócegas!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>HEY! Didn’t I tell ya to watch it?
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Yeesh... Guess I’ll go find a boulder that doesn’t move.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Ei! Eu não disse para você assistir?
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Yeesh... Acho que vou encontrar uma pedra que não se move.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Y’know, <$cdef(27)>Scizor, those pincers of yours are somethin’ else!
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>They both look just like heads!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Você sabe, <$cdef(27)>Scizor, essas suas pinças são outra coisa!
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>Parecem ambos cabeças!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)>RRRAAAGH!
<$voicel(2,6)><$motionoff(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,6)>You mean like that?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)>RRAAAGH!
<$voicel(2,6)><$motionoff(2,806)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,6)>quer dizer assim?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,634)><$comeff(1,23)>Whoa! Dang, that’s pretty scary!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,634)><$comeff(1,23)>Caramba, isso é muito assustador!

dialogues.en:
<$motionoff(1,635)><$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,805)><$comeff(2,1)>That pose makes me appear as though I have
three heads...
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,661)>Which causes many would-be opponents to flee in terror,
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>sparing me from unnecessary battles.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motionoff(1,635)><$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,805)><$comeff(2,1)>Essa pose faz-me parecer como se tivesse
Três cabeças...
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,661)>O que faz com que muitos pretendentes adversários fujam em terror,
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)>A poupar-me de batalhas desnecessárias.

dialogues.en:
<$motionoff(1,634)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>So you win without even having to fight by scaring
away opponents? Now THAT’S strategy!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motionoff(1,634)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Então ganhas sem sequer teres de lutar assustando
fora adversários? Agora isso é estratégia!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,3)>Wait, hold on... We’ve got six heads, right? But no one
ever <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,9)>gets scared of us. <$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,4)>They don’t take us seriously at all!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,3)>Espere, espere... Temos seis cabeças, certo? Mas ninguém
nunca <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,9)>fica com medo de nós. <$voicel(1,2)><$comeff(1,4)>Eles não nos levam a sério!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)>Probably ’cause you look like a wimp.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,17)>Provavelmente porque pareces um fracote.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,22)>What? We’ve got the same face, pal!<$motionoff(1,634)>
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,22)>O quê? Temos o mesmo rosto, amigo!<$motionoff(1,634)>

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,58)>Erm... Please don’t bicker.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,58)>Erm... Por favor, não discuta.

dialogues.en:
<$motionoff(1,635)><$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)>Yo, <$cdef(27)>Scizor, help us out here!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$motionoff(1,804)>Which of us do you think looks the strongest?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motionoff(1,635)><$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)>Yo, <$cdef(27)>ScizorAjudem-nos aqui!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$motionoff(1,804)>Qual de nós acha que é o mais forte?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,46)>Well... I’d say you all look fairly strong.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,46)>Bem... Eu diria que todos vocês parecem bastante fortes.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,634)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)>Ha! Yeah, of course you’d get it!
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)>That’s our pal <$cdef(27)>Scizor for ya!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,634)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)>Sim, é claro que você entenderia!
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)>Esse é o nosso amigo <$cdef(27)>Scizor Por ti!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Hey heyyy, <$cdef(27)>Exeggutor</color>! Got a quick question for ya...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Hey heyyy, <$cdef(27)>Exeggutor</color>Tenho uma pergunta rápida para ti...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,29)>Hmmm? Whaaat’s up?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,29)>O que está acontecendo?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>You got three heads, same as us. Y’all ever fight with
each other?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Você tem três cabeças, como nós.
Um ao outro?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,9)>Fight? Nawww. We’re always beeest buds.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,9)>Briga? Nawww. Somos sempre brotos de abelha.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Hey, I’m not sayin’ we’re not best buds, either. We’re the
bestest of buds! <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)>Except we always fight over food...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,29)>You know a good way for us to avoid gettin’ into fights?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Hey, Eu não estou dizendo’ nós não somos melhores amigos, também.
O melhor dos melhores amigos! <$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)>Só que nós sempre brigamos por comida...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,29)>Você sabe uma boa maneira para nós evitarmos entrar em brigas?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,13)>You fight over food? I dunnooo... Maybe just split things
nice and easy like friends? <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>How do you usually do it?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,13)>Não sei, talvez só dividir as coisas.
Com calma como amigos? <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>Como é que costumas fazê-lo?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,1)>I call dibs on all the sweet treats.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,1)>Chamo-me a mim em todas as guloseimas.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,27)>I take care of the spicy stuff.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,27)>Eu trato das coisas picantes.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,9)>And I gobble up the sour food.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,9)>E eu devoro a comida azeda.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)>Ohhh. What about stuff that’s both sweet AND sour?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)>Ohhh. E sobre coisas que são tanto doce e azedo?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,3)>I ate somethin’ sweet and sour recently. Things got ugly
real fast...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,3)>Eu comi algo’ doce e azedo recentemente. As coisas ficaram feias
Muito rápido...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,29)>Uhhh... Which one are yooouuu again?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,29)>Qual deles é que é você mesmo?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,14)>I eat spicy food.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,14)>Eu como comida picante.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,17)>Well, yeahhh. Even I think that’s kinda not OK.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,17)>Até eu acho que isso não está bem.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,51)>We fought about some bitter food too, didn’t we, fellas?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,51)>Brigamos também por causa de alguma comida amarga, não foi, amigos?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>Weeell, who’s in charge of the bitter foods?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,29)>Weeell, quem está no comando dos alimentos amargos?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,43)>These two didn’t wanna to eat it! That’s why I got
so mad!
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>We found a perfectly good berry and left it uneaten!
That’s wasteful, don’tcha think?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,43)>Esses dois não queriam comê-lo! É por isso que eu tenho
Tão louco!
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)>Encontramos uma baga perfeitamente boa e deixámo-la sem comer!
Isso é um desperdício, não acha?!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,805)>Why didn’t yooouuu eat it?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,805)>Por que você não comeu?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,31)>Ew, no, I hate bitter stuff.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,31)>Não, odeio coisas amargas.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,18)>... ... ...
Maybe you three just need to grooow up.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,18)>... ... ...
Talvez vocês os três só precisem de se divertir.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,2)><$kfacial(2)>*sniffle* Waaah! Waaaaaah!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,2)><$kfacial(2)>Waaah! Waaaaaah!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Gosh! What’s wrong? Why are you crying, <$cdef(27)>Misdreavus</color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Deus! O que há de errado? Por que você está chorando, <$cdef(27)>Misdreavus</color>?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)>*sob* Muuuh huh huh...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)>Muuuh huh huh...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Did something sad happen to you too?
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)><$comeff(1,2)>I totally get it. Every time I think about my mom I... I...
*sniffle* WAAAAAAH!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Também te aconteceu alguma coisa triste?
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)><$comeff(1,2)>Sempre que penso na minha mãe, eu...
* Sniffle* WAAAAAAH!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,802)>Waaah... Er—<wait(0.8)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,13)><$comeff(2,11)><$voicel(2,1)>what?! Now YOU’RE crying?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,802)>Waaah...<wait(0.8)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,13)><$comeff(2,11)><$voicel(2,1)>O quê?! Agora você está chorando?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,10)><$comeff(1,2)>Waaaaaah! Mommy... Where did you go, Mommy?
WAAAAAAAH!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,10)><$comeff(1,2)>Mamã, onde foste, mamã?
WAAAAAAH!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)>Um, I’m sorry! It was just a little prank! <$voicel(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>I didn’t think you’d
cry this hard...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)>Foi só uma brincadeira! <$voicel(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Eu não pensei que você iria
Chora tanto...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,802)>*sniffle* M...Mommy...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,802)>"Mamã..."

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,7)>I, er... I’m really sorry. I guess there’s only one thing to do
now: cry. <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,2)>Waaah! WAAAAAAH!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,7)>Eu, er... Eu realmente sinto muito. Eu acho que há apenas uma coisa a fazer
Agora: Chora. <$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,2)>Waaaaah!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,801)>So we finally get to spar, huh?
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)>Those legs of yours look like they’ve got more reach than
my punches. <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,806)>Gotta be sure I keep a safe distance.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,801)>Então, finalmente vamos lutar?
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)>Essas suas pernas parecem ter mais alcance do que
Os meus socos. <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,806)>Tenho de ter a certeza que mantenho uma distância segura.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,49)>Ohoho! Why, that’s a keen observation ya jus’ made.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>Well then! I’ll show ya what one of my kicks can do. Keep
yer eyes peeled now, y’hear? <$motion(1,815)>Hiyah!!!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,49)>Ohoho! Ora, essa é uma observação aguçada que você fez.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>Bem, então! Vou mostrar-lhe o que um dos meus chutes pode fazer.
Os teus olhos estão abertos, ouviste? <$motion(1,815)>Olá!!!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,13)><$motion(2,802)>What?! How did your legs stretch out so far? Are my eyes
playing tricks on me?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,13)><$motion(2,802)>Como é que as tuas pernas se estenderam até agora?
a pregar-me partidas?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Gwahaha! I can kick anyone, anywhere! There’s nowhere to
run when I come a-kickin’!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Gwahaha! Posso chutar qualquer um, em qualquer lugar!
correr quando eu vir a-kickin’!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Me, run? Not likely. In fact, let me return the favor by
showing you my punches. <$motion(2,200)>Hup-hup-HYAH!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Na verdade, deixe-me retribuir o favor por...
a mostrar-te os meus socos. <$motion(2,200)>Hup-hup-hyah!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>Well, I declare! That was faster than I expected...
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)>I could feel the air ’round yer fists heat up from the
sheer speed!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,27)>Foi mais rápido do que eu esperava.
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)>Eu podia sentir o ar ao redor de seus punhos se aquecendo do
Velocidade pura!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,10)>Heh. That’s ’cause I put my soul into each punch.
<$motion(2,817)><$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)>Enough talk—let us spar!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,10)>Isso é porque eu coloquei minha alma em cada soco.
<$motion(2,817)><$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)>Chega de conversa, vamos lutar!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$motionoff(1,804)>Hoo yeah! Don’tcha dare hold back now—’cause ya know
I sure won’t!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$motionoff(1,804)>Hoo yeah! Não se atreva a se conter agora - 'porque você sabe
Eu certamente não vou!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,200)><$comeff(2,5)>Yaaaaaah!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,200)><$comeff(2,5)>Yaaaaaah!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,5)>Gahhh! Hiyahhh!!!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,5)>- Olá!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>*sniff sniff* Hmmmm...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Cheirar cheiroso

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,29)>What is it?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,29)>O que foi?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,6)>Whenever I’m with you, there’s always the nicest smell...
I wonder what it is.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,6)>Sempre que estou com você, há sempre o cheiro mais agradável...
Pergunto-me o que será.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)>Huh? I dunno... Maybe it’s the berries I have?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)>Não sei... talvez sejam as frutas que eu tenho?

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,807)>Naw, it’s not that. It smells even nicer than berries...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,807)>Não, não é isso. Cheira ainda melhor do que bagas...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,806)>Huh... I don’t have anything else with me. I dunno what
it could be!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,806)>Huh... Eu não tenho mais nada comigo. Eu não sei o que
Pode ser!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Oh! It smells even stronger now... *sniff sniff* *sniff sniff*
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,39)>I got it—it’s the smell of your vines!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Cheira ainda mais forte agora.
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,39)>Eu entendi – é o cheiro das suas vinhas!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,16)><$motion(1,803)>Whoa, really? My vines? You think my vines smell nice?
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Hee hee! That makes me kinda happy!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,16)><$motion(1,803)>Achas que as minhas vinhas cheiram bem?
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Isso faz-me feliz!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Mmm, yeah, they smell WONDERFUL. It’s the bestest
smell I think I’ve ever smelled...
<$comeff(2,7)>...*rumble*
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)>Y’know, your vines smell so tasty...and my tummy is just
about running on empty here...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Mmm, sim, eles cheiram maravilhosamente.
cheiro que eu acho que eu já cheirei...
<$comeff(2,7)>...*rumble*
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)>Você sabe, suas vinhas cheiram tão saboroso ... e minha barriga é apenas
sobre correr em vazio aqui...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,27)>Wha—?! No, don’t eat them!
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Here! Look, I’ll give you a berry—just don’t eat my vines!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,27)>O quê?! Não, não coma!
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Aqui! Olha, vou te dar uma baga – apenas não coma minhas videiras!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,816)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>Hup! Shwaaah!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,816)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>Shwaaah!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,5)>Wow! That’s some mighty fine speed and precision, if I do
say so myself!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,5)>Uau! Isso é alguma velocidade e precisão muito fina, se eu fizer
Eu mesmo o digo!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Heh, thanks! These scythes of mine are extra sharp today!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Estas minhas foices estão mais afiadas hoje!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,3)>My claws aren’t too shabby either, y’know! Watch this!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,814)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)>Zree! Drrrrrrrrr!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,3)>Minhas garras também não são muito ruins, você sabe! Veja isso!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,814)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)>Zree, Drrrrrrrrrrrr!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Whoa, those things pack a powerful punch! And that shine
on your drill... Gotta say, I’m impressed!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Essas coisas dão um soco poderoso!
na sua broca... Tenho que dizer, estou impressionado!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Heh... Comin’ from a strong Pokémon like you, I’ll gladly
take that compliment.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Heh... Vindo de um forte Pokémon como você, eu vou com prazer
Aceita esse elogio.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Ha! I could say the same, pal.<$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)><$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>. Were you watchin’ us?
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)>Well, whaddya think? We’re both pretty amazing, right?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Posso dizer o mesmo, amigo.<$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)><$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, Oh, <$cdef(27)>. Você estava nos observando?
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)>Bem, o que você acha? Nós dois somos muito surpreendentes, certo?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Heh, you must be pretty sharp to recognize our greatness.
You got promise, <$cdef(27)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>deve ser muito esperto para reconhecer a nossa grandeza.
tem uma promessa. <$cdef(27)>!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Now I’m feelin’ even more flattered! This has me inspired

<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)>Eu virei acordá-lo exatamente à mesma hora todos os dias,
Para que possas descansar!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,39)><$pkcry;0(2,2)>! That’s super helpful. Thanks, <$cdef(27)>Hoothoot</color>!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,39)><$pkcry;0(2,2)>! Isso é super útil. Obrigado, <$cdef(27)>Hoothoot</color>!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>Salutations, <$cdef(27)>Chandelure. I see your flames are as beautiful
as ever.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>Saudações, <$cdef(27)>ChandelureVejo que as tuas chamas são tão lindas
Como sempre.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Why thank you. That’s a kind thing to say.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Por que obrigado. Isso é uma coisa gentil de se dizer.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Whenever I see that bewitching light, it seems my
mind grows clear and sharp.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>And I’m able to ponder things far, far more deeply than
usual.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Sempre que vejo aquela luz enfeitiçada, parece o meu
A mente fica clara e afiada.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>E eu sou capaz de ponderar as coisas muito, muito mais profundamente do que
habitual.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)>I’m honored to be of service.
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,7)>Though I’m sad to say my flames have lost some of their
previous vibrancy...<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,17)> They seem smaller now, too.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)>Sinto - me honrado de ser útil.
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,7)>Embora eu estou triste de dizer que minhas chamas perderam alguns de seus
Vibração anterior...<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,17)> Eles parecem mais pequenos agora, também.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Oh dear... That’s not any good. Can you think of a reason
why?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Oh querida... Isso não é bom. Você pode pensar em uma razão
Porquê?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Well, I imagine it’s the lack of spirits. I’ve not absorbed
one for a while now.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Bem, eu imagino que é a falta de espíritos. Eu não absorvi
Um por uns tempos.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,29)>Spirits?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,29)>Espíritos?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)>You see, my flames<$motion(2,816)> come from the spirits of departed
humans and Pokémon.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)>vê, as minhas chamas<$motion(2,816)> vêm dos espíritos de falecidos
Humanos e Pokémon.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)>I see. How fascinating.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)>Estou a ver, que fascinante.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)>To all appearances, humans have completely vanished...
<$voicel(2,5)>And there are still precious few Pokémon, as well.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>And since <$cdef(27)> is working tirelessly
to
fix that...
<$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,816)><$comeff(2,10)>I can’t very well take the spirits of the Pokémon around
here, can I?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)>Parece que os humanos desapareceram completamente...
<$voicel(2,5)>E ainda há poucos preciosos Pokémon, também.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>E desde então... <$cdef(27)> está trabalhando incansavelmente
para
Conserte isso...
<$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,816)><$comeff(2,10)>Eu não posso muito bem levar os espíritos do Pokémon ao redor
Aqui, posso?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>I...I see...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>Estou a ver...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>But if I could acquire the spirit of a Pokémon as wise and
as dignified as you...<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>surely my flames would burn more
brilliantly than ever before.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Mas se eu pudesse adquirir o espírito de um Pokémon como sábio e
tão digno como tu...<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>As minhas chamas queimariam mais.
Brilhantemente do que nunca antes.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,27)>...Oh my!
<$voicel(1,2)>I, erm...<$emotion(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)>I just remembered an errand that requires my
attention, so I must immediately excuse myself!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,27)>Oh, meu!
<$voicel(1,2)>Eu...<$emotion(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)>Lembrei-me de uma missão que requer a minha
Atenção, por isso devo desculpar-me imediatamente!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,10)>Don’t be silly. I was only joking!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,10)>Não seja bobo. Eu só estava brincando!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, no! <$cdef(27)>Tyrogue</color>, dear, you’re injured! <$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,4)>Are you all right?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, não! <$cdef(27)>Tyrogue</color>, querida, você está ferida! <$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,4)>está bem?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,5)>Yeah, I’m all good! <$voicel(2,6)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(2,803)>I always get like this after training.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>I gotta work hard if I wanna get big, strong muscles!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,5)>Sim, estou bem! <$voicel(2,6)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(2,803)>Fico sempre assim depois do treino.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Tenho de trabalhar muito se quero ficar grande e forte!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Hee hee, I’m sure you will, dear! But please don’t
overdo it.
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>If you really want to grow strong, you need to prioritize
recuperation and good nutrition!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Hee hee, tenho certeza que você vai, querida! Mas por favor, não
Exagere.
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Se você realmente quer crescer forte, você precisa priorizar
recuperação e boa nutrição!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>Ree-cooper...ayshon? Noo-trish-un?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>Ree-cooper...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,21)>That just means getting plenty of rest and plenty of food!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)>Speaking of which, I’ve got a present for you!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,21)>Isso significa descansar bastante e muita comida!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)>Falando nisso, tenho um presente para você!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,21)>Whoa, that looks yummy! Thanks a bunch for looking out
for me, <$cdef(27)>Slowking!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,21)>Obrigado por terem cuidado.
para mim, <$cdef(27)>Slowking!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>And there’s more where that came from! Here, take this,
too...and this... And this!
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>You’re young, so you need to get plenty to eat!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)>E há mais de onde isso veio! Aqui, tome isto,
E isto... e isto... e isto!
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Você é jovem, então precisa comer bastante!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,9)>You sure? This sure is a lot. I dunno if I can eat it all...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,9)>Isto é mesmo muito, não sei se consigo comer tudo.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,10)>Hee hee hee... You know, I just happen to have some time
on my hands right now.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>So I’ll just keep you company <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,8)>until you eat aaallll of those
up and fall into a nice, refreshing sleep!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,10)>sabe, por acaso tenho algum tempo para te ver.
nas minhas mãos agora.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>Então eu vou apenas fazer-lhe companhia <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,8)>até que comas tudo isso.
Para cima e cair em um sono agradável, refrescante!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)>Um, no thanks. If I eat all that I won’t be able to move!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)>Um, não obrigado. Se eu comer tudo isso eu não vou ser capaz de se mover!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>*sniff sniff* Hey! I’d know that delicious smell anywhere!
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>You’ve been out collectin’ nectar, haven’t ya?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)>*Sniff sniff* Hey! Eu saberia que cheiro delicioso em qualquer lugar!
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Você tem saído para recolher néctar, não é?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,27)>Eep! <$cdef(27)>Heracross! Don’t tell me...you want nectar again,
don’t you?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,27)>Eep! <$cdef(27)>HeracrossNão me diga... você quer néctar de novo,
não acha?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Heh! Guilty as charged! *droooool*
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Maybe you could share some with me, eh? Just a little bit?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Culpado da acusação!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Talvez pudesses partilhar um pouco comigo, não é?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)>No way!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,1)>Last time you said that, <$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,7)>you ate ALL the nectar I had!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)>Nem pensar!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,1)>Da última vez que disseste isso, <$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,662)><$facial(2,7)>Comeste todo o néctar que eu tinha!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Awww, c’mon!<$facial(1,1)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,48)>I’m not even that hungry! A taste is all I’m askin for...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Awww, vamos lá!<$facial(1,1)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,48)>Eu não estou nem com fome! Um gosto é tudo o que eu estou pedindo...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>But I collected this to give to the queen!
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)>There’s still lotsa nectar in the flower fields—go get
some yourself!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Mas recolhi isto para dar à rainha!
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)>Ainda há muito néctar nos campos de flores — vá buscar
Alguns para ti!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)>Hrnnngh...
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>You can’t spare even a teensy-weensy drop for your ol’
pal <$cdef(27)>Heracross?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)>Hrnnngh...
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Você não pode dispensar nem mesmo uma gota teensy-weensy para o seu ol '
amigo <$cdef(27)>Heracross?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,662)>NO! No matter how many times you ask me, the answer’s
still NO!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,662)>NÃO! Não importa quantas vezes você me pergunte, a resposta
Ainda não!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)>Awwwwww...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)>Awww.www....

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,7)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>... I can’t decide. Should I focus on
punching or kicking? Hmmm...
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,6)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Hitmontop, which one do you think is better?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,7)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>... Eu não consigo decidir. Devo me concentrar
Socar ou chutar?
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,6)>Olá. <$cdef(27)>Hitmontop, qual você acha que é melhor?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Y’know, that’s a GREAT question, <$cdef(27)>Tyrogue! I agonized over
that same decision back in the day! I worried myself
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>round and round in circles...until I found THE ANSWER!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,14)>Você sabe, essa é uma grande pergunta, <$cdef(27)>TyrogueEu agonizei
essa mesma decisão no passado! Eu me preocupei
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>redondo e redondo em círculos ... até que eu encontrei a resposta!

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Oh yeah?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Ai sim?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>You should focus on...BOTH! And...NEITHER! The true
answer to life is SPINNING! YEAHHH! SPIN TO WIN!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Você deve concentrar-se em ... ambos! E ... também! O verdadeiro
A resposta para a vida é SPINING!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>S-spinning?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>Girando?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,815)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)>YEAH! You should spin—just like this! That way you can
punch and kick at the SAME TIME!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,815)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)>Sim! Você deve girar - assim mesmo! Assim você pode
Socar e chutar ao mesmo tempo!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)>Uh... That doesn’t really help me pick...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)>Uh... Isso realmente não me ajuda a escolher...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comcan(1)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,21)>Ultimate defense! Unstoppable attacks! Spinning on your
head gives you BOTH and frees up your arms AND legs!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>It’s a total waste to only specialize in a single thing!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,7)><$comcan(1)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,21)>Defesa final! Ataques imparáveis! Girando em seu
cabeça dá-lhe ambos e liberta os braços e pernas!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>É um desperdício total para apenas se especializar em uma única coisa!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>Um...OK. I think <wait(0.5)>I need to think about this more...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>Está bem, eu acho. <wait(0.5)>Tenho de pensar nisto mais...
